title: Yellowed Indulgent Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A malty, shattering, indulgent Saudi-Arabian dish featuring Sichuan pepper and tadka, this kosher-friendly recipe is perfect for special occasions. The combination of flavors and textures will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, making sure the grates are clean and brush them with oil to prevent sticking.
In a large bowl, whisk together the toasted Sichuan pepper, coriander, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together the melted ghee, yogurt, lemon juice, and garlic.
Brush the mixture onto the lamb cubes, making sure they are well coated.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they are cooked to the desired level of doneness.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and a side of tadka sauce if desired.
